intent: REFACTOR BoundedEventChannel: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Shared in-process event channel implementing the integration rule: contexts talk only through bounded Reactor sinks with explicit backpressure. Generic final class BoundedEventChannel<T>(String name, int capacity>0 else IllegalArgumentException). Mono<Void> publish(T event): non-blocking, rejects null; backed by Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(capacity, false); retries only FAIL_NON_SERIALIZED emission; on FAIL_OVERFLOW returns Mono.error(new BoundedEventChannel.OverflowException(name)) - never blocks, never silently drops. Flux<T> stream() returns sink.asFlux(). String name(). Public static nested class OverflowException extends RuntimeException.
